title: Succession
learning_outcomes: Explain ownership and beneficiaries in the context of succession.
Compare and distinguish continuity risks in the context of succession.
Apply governance in the context of succession.
Evaluate and justify decisions about professional advice in the context of succession.

lessons.title: Ownership and beneficiaries
lessons.outcome: Explain ownership and beneficiaries in the context of succession.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving ownership and beneficiaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to succession checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain ownership and beneficiaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of ownership and beneficiaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Continuity risks
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish continuity risks in the context of succession.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving continuity risks; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to succession checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain continuity risks from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of continuity risks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Governance
lessons.outcome: Apply governance in the context of succession.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving governance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to succession checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain governance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of governance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Professional advice
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about professional advice in the context of succession.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving professional advice; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to succession checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain professional advice from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of professional advice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of ownership and beneficiaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of continuity risks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of governance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of professional advice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
